summary_rationale: DigitalOcean re-accelerated Q3 2026 revenue 40% YoY to $321.2M ($1,285M ARR) and grew RPO to $799.7M, backed by $376M in AI Customer ARR, 60% revenue from 4+ product users, and an ~8%–9% S&M ratio. However, primary Q3 2026 filings reveal heavy structural trade-offs: GAAP gross margin dropped ~980 bps to 50.1%, top-51 $1M+ customers generate 30% of revenue ($386M ARR) alongside a single-customer $107.4M post-Q3 prepayment, and NDR disclosures were discontinued. On the balance sheet, finance lease and equipment financing liabilities surged 7x to $923.6M PV alongside $666.6M operating leases, $2,955.2M of off-balance-sheet uncommenced 11.1-year colocation leases, a $785M MUFG equipment facility, and $312.3M of 2026 notes due December 1, 2026. Combined with +28.2% YTD share dilution, a new $1.0B ATM equity shelf, +82% YoY Q3 SBC growth ($36.0M), and November 19 CFO Form 144 selling, the business remains a capital-intensive CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL infrastructure transition rather than an asset-light compounder.
